name: Vigilant Paradise
storyline: After accumulating a little too much overtime fighting crime in unconventional ways, renegade plain-clothed policemen Vince Dimare and Paolo Diterra have been put on forced vacation. Only a few days in, Vince laments the boredom of having so little to do. But, in the City of Paradise, he may not be so bored for very long...
summary: Vigilant Paradise is a brand-new first person shooter for the Sega Saturn. It was a self-funded, five-year journey of many a late night. My personal quest to make an exclusive first person shooter for the beloved, underrated console; and relive some of the magic of mid-90's gaming.
